newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: OPTIONS -- EOE dominated by ABN-AMRO calls.
newsitem.headline: OPTIONS -- EOE dominated by ABN-AMRO calls.

text.p: Trade on the European Options Exchange was dominated on Monday by call options in bank ABN-AMRO as players approved Friday's acquisition of Standard Federal in the U.S., traders said.
The sharply higher share market had also left investors looking for calls in strong financial shares, one said.
Overall trade was brisk, with calls swamping puts by around 130,000 to 46,000. In ABN, calls led puts by nearly 37,000 to 9,000.
